pages.text: The Soulium Dagger is used to collect souls from mobs. These souls are collected using $(l:souls/soul_jars)Soul Jars$(). Souls are collected by killing mobs with the Soulium Dagger $(br2)The Soulium Dagger can be upgraded using an $(l:basics/infusion_altar)Infusion Altar$(), improving soul collection efficiency.
The Passive Attuned Soulium Dagger provides an additional +50 percent souls gathered from passive mobs.
The Hostile Attuned Soulium Dagger provides an additional +50 percent souls gathered from hostile mobs.
